options.label: Model provider
options.help: Who plays the god: Claude, OpenAI, or your own server (its address is in config.yml).

options.label: Model profile
options.help: Lite suits small local models: few powers, a short prompt. Auto: lite for a server on this network.

options.label: Model sees images
options.help: Whether its look power sends pictures. Auto: yes for OpenAI, no for other servers.

options.label: Longest reply (other)
options.help: The longest one reply may be, for OpenAI and other servers.

options.label: Model timeout
options.help: How long to wait for a reply to start. Raise it for a slow local model.

options.label: Model context size
options.help: What your local model can hold at once; perceptions are cut to fit. 0: large enough.

options.label: Most gods per world
options.help: How many gods may share one world, the first included (/god create).

options.label: New god's power
options.help: The power of a god made without one. Change any god's on its Might & Mind page.

options.label: Tab list
options.help: The god's name and state at the top of the player list.

options.label: Usage in console
options.help: Print a usage line for every request to the console.

options.label: usage.csv
options.help: Append every request to usage.csv.

options.label: Log perceptions
options.help: Print everything the god sees each thought (very long).

options.label: Island rounds
options.help: The old round game mode: islands, resets and teams.

options.label: Save its sight
options.help: Save every image it looks at to the plugin folder.

options.label: Send skin pack
options.help: Offer players the pack with its own skins and textures.

options.label: Pack required
options.help: Players must accept the pack to stay.

options.label: Mind viewer port
options.help: The port of the web page that shows its mind.

options.label: Bridge port
options.help: The port of the local test bridge.

options.label: Debug bridge
options.help: The local HTTP API for test harnesses and external brains.

options.label: Mind viewer
options.help: A web page to watch and edit each god's mind live. The URL is in the console.
